title: Hume Center funded by former CIA S&T officer Ted Hume
summary: Bob McGwier tells of Hume Center funded by former CIA S&T officer Ted Hume, about undated at Virginia Tech, Blacksburg, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: to tell you the Hume Center was funded by science and technology guy from CIA named Ted Hugh and his wife Ted was left CIA started a company did well sold it to kinetic and plowed some of the money back into the center

plain: An engineer named Bob McGwier, who worked with the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says the Hume Center at Virginia Tech, a university in Blacksburg, Virginia, was funded by Ted Hume, a former CIA science and technology officer, and his wife. McGwier says Hume left the CIA, started a company that did well, sold it to a firm called Kinetic, and put some of the money back into the center. He tells it to explain where the center he was part of came from.
